svg.aria-label: Animation of one token passing through 12 engine stages. Before, 1 stage did real work and logits were all zeros. After, 11 do, logits match Hugging Face, and 28 of 28 kernel checks pass. The tokenizer is still a placeholder.
svg.text: One token going through the engine. Watch which stages do real work.
The old benchmark reported 2,734 tokens/s, but its kernels were empty and it computed nothing from a model,
so it can't be compared with today's rate. The tokenizer is still a placeholder: BPE isn't implemented, and benchmarks use token IDs.
